title: Expiry Reminders and the Homesite Reservation Reinstatement Fee
content:
The reinstatement reminder method of the Homesite Reservation reinstatement fee is judged by the courtesy expiry reminders on the reservation ledger, that is, the notice entries with notice type expiry reminder, compared with the hold expiry date of the expired hold.

**Clause.** Where no expiry reminder was sent, the total is charged pro rata: multiplied by the calendar days from the date the hold expired to today and divided by the class's reinstatement window days, and rounded half up to the cent. Where the latest expiry reminder was sent fewer than the class's expiry reminder days before the hold expiry date, the total is halved and rounded up to the next cent. Where it was sent the class's expiry reminder days or more before the hold expiry date, the total is charged as it stands.

## Class figures used by the clause

| Premium class | Expiry reminder days before the hold expiry date | Reinstatement window days |
|---|---|---|
| Interior Homesite | 3 | 3 |
| Corner Homesite | 3 | 3 |
| Cul-de-Sac Homesite | 3 | 2 |
| Greenbelt Homesite | 2 | 2 |
| Water-View Homesite | 2 | 1 |
| Golf-Frontage Homesite | 2 | 1 |

## Worked cases (hypothetical total of 262.51 before this method, Interior Homesite, hold expiry date 10 August, date the hold expired 11 August, reinstatement taken 12 August)

| Expiry reminders on the ledger | Lead of the latest reminder | Method | Amount |
|---|---|---|---|
| none | | pro rata: 262.51 multiplied by 1 and divided by 3, rounded half up | 87.50 |
| latest sent 8 August | 2 days, fewer than 3 | halved, rounded up to the next cent | 131.26 |
| latest sent 7 August | 3 days, not fewer than 3 | as it stands | 262.51 |

The lead is the calendar days from the date the latest expiry reminder was sent to the hold expiry date.
